definitions.explanation: A small, rounded amount of liquid, such as a raindrop, teardrop, or dewdrop. Evokes a poetic, somewhat literary image.

examples.japanese: ⟦{葉|は}っぱ→葉っぱ：05388_happa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{滴|しずく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぽたり⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{落|お}ちた→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧。
examples.english: A drop fell from a leaf with a plop.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝露|あさつゆ}→朝露：08012_asatsuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{滴|しずく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{花|はな}びら→花びら：13988_hanabira⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{光|ひか}っていた→光る：01163_hikaru⟧。
examples.english: Droplets of morning dew were glistening on the petals.

notes:
{滴|しずく} refers to a single drop of liquid — water, rain, tears, dew, etc. A somewhat literary and poetic word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{滴|しずく}: raindrop
- ⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{滴|しずく}: teardrop
- ⟦{露|つゆ}→露：02233_tsuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{滴|しずく}: dewdrop
- {滴|しずく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧: a drop falls
- {滴|しずく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{垂|た}れる→垂れる：10075_tareru⟧: a drop drips

WRITING:
Often written in hiragana (しずく) rather than the kanji {滴|しずく}, especially in casual and literary contexts.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {滴|しずく}: a drop (poetic, literary)
- ⟦{水滴|すいてき}→水滴：04296_suiteki⟧: water drop (more technical/neutral)
- ⟦{一滴|いってき}→一滴：08893_itteki⟧: a single drop (emphasis on small quantity)

USAGE:
A popular Japanese name for girls (しずく), evoking purity and nature.
